title: A proper scheme over a qcqs base is a limit of proper finitely presented schemes along closed immersions
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism] with $S$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Then there are a nonempty directed set $I$ and an inverse system $(X_i)_{i\in I}$ of $S$-schemes, together with $S$-morphisms $X\to X_i$ compatible with the transition morphisms, such that every $X_i\to S$ is proper and of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], every transition morphism $X_{i'}\to X_i$ ($i'\ge i$) and every morphism $X\to X_i$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and $X=\varprojlim_iX_i$ in the category of schemes [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. In particular there is a closed immersion $X\to Y$ over $S$ with $Y\to S$ proper and of finite presentation.
